title: Intelligence Source Registry Entry
description: Schema for a registered trade/classification intelligence source. Conservative by design: sources are not downstream-safe and not assumed fresh unless explicitly reviewed and verified.

source_id.description: Stable identifier of the logical intelligence source.

source_type.description: Source family used for intelligence classification.

authority_level.description: How authoritative the source is for the topics it covers.

reliability_level.description: Assessed reliability of the source content.

jurisdiction_scope.description: Geographic breadth of the source's authority.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code when the source is national/subnational.

regional_scope.description: Named regional bloc/scope when jurisdiction_scope is regional (e.g. MERCOSUR).

topic_scope.description: Topics/domains the source informs (e.g. hs_nomenclature, ncm_tariff).

language.description: Primary content language as a BCP-47 / ISO 639 code (e.g. en, es, pt).

source_locator.description: Stable locator for the source (sample/demo or verified official locator).

official_url.description: Optional canonical official URL once a verified source is onboarded.

verification_status.description: Whether the locator points at a verified official source or a non-authoritative sample.

expected_update_cadence.description: How often the source is expected to change. Used by freshness helpers.

interval_days.description: Optional explicit cadence in days, overriding the label mapping.

last_checked_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last freshness check, when available.

freshness_status.description: Conservative freshness classification. Missing data must never read as current.

human_review_required.description: Must be true for intelligence that may affect classification/compliance.

downstream_allowed.description: Whether this source may back downstream-consumable artifacts. Defaults to false.

limitations.description: Optional known limitations of this source.

metadata.description: Optional extra metadata for local traceability.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the registry entry was created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the registry entry was last updated.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this registry entry payload.
